senate.description: University of Minnesota Landscape Arboretum providing free access to a guest of a disabled veteran request provision

Senate.text: Referred to Agriculture, Veterans, Broadband, and Rural Development

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to veterans; requesting the University of Minnesota Landscape Arboretum to provide free access to a guest of a disabled veteran; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 137.375.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 137.375, is amended to read:

137.375 DISABLED VETERANS; UNIVERSITY OF MINNESOTA LANDSCAPE ARBORETUM.
(a) For purposes of this section, "disabled veteran" means a veteran as defined in section 197.447 who is certified as disabled. "Certified as disabled" means certified in writing by the United States Department of Veterans Affairs or the state commissioner of veterans affairs as having a permanent service-connected disability.
(b) The University of Minnesota Landscape Arboretum is requested to provide a disabled veteran [+and one guest +]unlimited access to the University of Minnesota Landscape Arboretum located in the city of Chaska free of charge. The disabled veteran must provide a veteran photo identification card with the term "service-connected" on the identification card, verifying that the disabled veteran has a service-connected disability.
